scope: bounded pure ordinary-terrain hand surface response and explicit remake robustness policies; not full original hand behavior or runtime fidelity certification
resolvedReviewFindings: Clarified terminal velocity v=0 rather than ambiguous v0.
Specified radial Euclidean surface_distance, not camera-forward depth.
Specified finite large normal normalization without length overflow.
Specified state before successful reset and exact two-file JSON response shape.
Made repeated-facing and previous-output-scale fixtures numerically explicit.
passedReviewCriteria: Pure caller-supplied scalar/vector API has no scenes, animation, meshes, input, assets, filesystem or network.
Configure/reset/step validation, replacement, unchanged invalid state, and fresh snapshots are defined.
Every-step retarget preserves raw internal scalar positions and velocities; normalized output is not fed back into facing controllers.
Depth and facing scheduling inputs remain separate; no unsupported FPS invariance claim.
Previous-output scale clearance and immediate visible cap are distinct from internal trajectory.
Maximum1800 is a supported input range, not an original default maximum claim; base scale is caller supplied.
Independently recomputed scale, derivative, repeated-frame, facing, and cached-scale fixtures from the equations.
Huge finite durations settle in bounded work; clipping and zero-vector fallback are explicitly new defensive policies.
limitations: Reviewer has coordinator and research context as allowed for review; this is not clean implementer provenance.
